# Pattern checklist

Every rule the sloplint CLI checks (93 in total), grouped by category. Each entry says what to look for, why readers react to it, and how to fix it. Severity is the CLI default: `error` and `warning` should be fixed, `info` is a prompt to reread.

## Openers

Stock first lines that delay the point.

### opener/fast-paced-world

"In today's fast-paced world". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A stock opener that delays the point and could precede any text about anything.
- Fix: Delete it and open with the concrete problem or the news.
- Flagged: `In today's fast-paced world, developers need better tools.`, `In today's digital age, every business needs a website.`, `In this ever-evolving world of AI, staying ahead matters.`, `In this day and age, nobody reads manuals.`
- Not flagged: `Today's release fixes the login bug.`, `The world record was set in 1998.`, `In today's standup we agreed to ship on Friday.`

### opener/ever-evolving-landscape

"The ever-evolving landscape". Default: `warning`.

- Why: "Landscape" and "navigating the complexities" are filler metaphors that signal generated text.
- Fix: Name the field and the specific change you mean.
- Flagged: `In the ever-evolving landscape of web development, tooling matters.`, `Navigating the complexities of modern deployment can be daunting.`, `The digital landscape has changed.`
- Not flagged: `The landscape photos load lazily.`, `Rapidly changing requirements broke the schema twice.`, `We navigate the file tree with arrow keys.`

### opener/imagine-a-world

"Imagine a world where…". Default: `warning`.

- Why: An ad-copy hook that asks the reader to do work before you have told them anything.
- Fix: State what the thing does. If the scenario matters, describe a real one.
- Flagged: `Imagine a world where deployments never fail.`, `Picture this: it's 2 a.m. and your pager goes off.`, `Imagine never having to write a migration again.`, `What if I told you there's a better way?`
- Not flagged: `Imagine is a song by John Lennon.`, `The test should imagine a user with no permissions.`, `Picture this component as a pipeline.`

### opener/lets-dive-in

"Let's dive in". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Announces that content is coming instead of delivering it.
- Fix: Delete the sentence. The next paragraph is the start.
- Flagged: `Let's dive in.`, `Without further ado, here are the results.`, `Buckle up, because this release is big.`, `Let's unpack what that means.`
- Not flagged: `We dive into the parser internals in part two.`, `The diving team won.`, `Break the task into steps.`

### opener/rhetorical-hook

"Have you ever wondered…?". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A rhetorical question used as a hook. Readers skip it to find the actual claim.
- Fix: Replace the question with the answer.
- Flagged: `Have you ever wondered why your builds are slow?`, `Tired of flaky tests?`, `Are you struggling to keep up with your inbox?`, `What if you could ship twice as fast?`
- Not flagged: `I wondered why the build was slow, so I profiled it.`, `Have you run the migration yet?`, `Ever since the upgrade, builds take 4 minutes.`

### opener/chatbot-preamble

"Certainly! Here's…". Default: `error`.

- Why: Chat-assistant preamble pasted into the final text. It tells the reader nobody edited this.
- Fix: Delete the preamble and keep only the content.
- Flagged: `Certainly! Here's a README for your project.`, `Great question! The answer depends on your setup.`, `Here is a comprehensive overview of the API.`, `Absolutely! Below is the updated version.`
- Not flagged: `Certainly not before Friday.`, `Sure, that works for me.`, `Here is the overview of the API.`, `The question was a good one.`

### opener/hope-finds-you-well

"I hope this email finds you well". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Template email openers spend the most-read line of the message on nothing.
- Fix: Open with the reason you are writing.
- Flagged: `I hope this email finds you well.`, `Just circling back on my last note.`, `I wanted to reach out about your hiring plans.`, `Hope you're doing well!`
- Not flagged: `The well was dry.`, `We reached out to three vendors and two replied.`, `Following up on Tuesday's call: the contract is attached.`

### opener/tr-stock-opening

Konudan önce gelen genel giriş. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Konudan önce gelen genel giriş. Bu ifade, somut bilgi yerine hazır bir anlatım kalıbı kullanıyor.
- Fix: Kalıbı kaldırın; yerine somut bilgiyi, sonucu veya yapılacak işi yazın.
- Flagged: `Günümüzün hızla değişen dünyasında araçlar önemlidir.`, `Günümüzün dijital çağında veriler değerlidir.`
- Not flagged: `Bugün giriş hatasını düzelttik.`, `Dijital çağ arşivin adıdır.`, `Teknoloji bütçesi yüzde beş arttı.`

### opener/it-stock-opening

nel mondo frenetico di oggi. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Questa formula generica ritarda i fatti e potrebbe comparire in un testo su qualsiasi argomento.
- Fix: Elimina la formula e indica il fatto, il risultato o la prossima azione concreta.
- Flagged: `nel mondo frenetico di oggi.`, `nell'era digitale odierna.`
- Not flagged: `Abbiamo corretto il problema di accesso.`, `Il file occupa due megabyte.`, `Il modello funziona senza rete.`

### opener/nl-stock-opening

in de snel veranderende wereld van vandaag. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Deze algemene formulering stelt concrete informatie uit en past bij vrijwel ieder onderwerp.
- Fix: Schrap de formulering en noem het concrete feit, resultaat of de volgende stap.
- Flagged: `in de snel veranderende wereld van vandaag.`, `in het huidige digitale tijdperk.`
- Not flagged: `We hebben de inlogfout verholpen.`, `Het bestand is twee megabyte groot.`, `Het model werkt zonder netwerk.`

### opener/ru-stock-opening

в современном быстро меняющемся мире. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Этот шаблонный оборот откладывает конкретную информацию и подходит почти к любой теме.
- Fix: Уберите шаблон и укажите конкретный факт, результат или следующее действие.
- Flagged: `в современном быстро меняющемся мире.`, `в эпоху цифровых технологий.`
- Not flagged: `Мы исправили ошибку входа.`, `Размер файла — два мегабайта.`, `Модель работает без сети.`

### opener/ar-stock-opening

في عالم اليوم سريع التغير. Default: `warning`.

- Why: هذه عبارة عامة تؤخر المعلومة المحددة ويمكن استخدامها في نص عن أي موضوع تقريبا.
- Fix: احذف العبارة واذكر المعلومة المحددة أو النتيجة أو الخطوة التالية.
- Flagged: `في عالم اليوم سريع التغير.`, `في عصرنا الرقمي المتسارع.`
- Not flagged: `أصلحنا خطأ تسجيل الدخول.`, `حجم الملف اثنان ميغابايت.`, `يعمل النموذج دون اتصال بالشبكة.`

### opener/es-stock-opening

en el vertiginoso mundo actual. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica retrasa la información concreta y puede aparecer en textos sobre cualquier tema.
- Fix: Elimina la fórmula y escribe el dato, el resultado o la acción concreta.
- Flagged: `en el vertiginoso mundo actual.`, `en la era digital actual.`
- Not flagged: `Hoy corregimos el error de acceso.`, `El archivo ocupa dos megabytes.`, `El modelo funciona sin conexión.`

### opener/fr-stock-opening

dans le monde en constante évolution d'aujourd'hui. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Cette formule générique retarde les faits et pourrait figurer dans un texte sur presque tous les sujets.
- Fix: Supprimez la formule et indiquez le fait, le résultat ou la prochaine action.
- Flagged: `dans le monde en constante évolution d'aujourd'hui.`, `à l'ère numérique actuelle.`
- Not flagged: `Nous avons corrigé l’erreur de connexion.`, `Le fichier mesure deux mégaoctets.`, `Le modèle fonctionne sans connexion.`

### opener/de-stock-opening

in der heutigen schnelllebigen Welt. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Diese allgemeine Floskel verzögert die konkrete Information und passt zu fast jedem beliebigen Thema.
- Fix: Streichen Sie die Floskel und nennen Sie die konkrete Information, das Ergebnis oder den nächsten Schritt.
- Flagged: `in der heutigen schnelllebigen Welt.`, `im heutigen digitalen Zeitalter.`
- Not flagged: `Wir haben den Anmeldefehler behoben.`, `Die Datei ist zwei Megabyte groß.`, `Das Modell arbeitet ohne Netzwerk.`

### opener/pt-stock-opening

no mundo acelerado de hoje. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica adia a informação concreta e poderia aparecer em textos sobre qualquer assunto.
- Fix: Remova a fórmula e apresente o dado, o resultado ou a ação concreta.
- Flagged: `no mundo acelerado de hoje.`, `na era digital em que vivemos.`
- Not flagged: `Corrigimos o erro de acesso hoje.`, `O arquivo ocupa dois megabytes.`, `O modelo funciona sem conexão.`

## Vocabulary

Words and phrases strongly associated with generated text.

### vocab/delve

"Delve". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Rare in human writing, extremely common in model output. Readers now treat it as a tell.
- Fix: Use "look at", "cover", "explain", or just start explaining.
- Flagged: `Let's delve into the details.`, `This guide delves into caching.`, `We delved deep into the logs.`
- Not flagged: `The developer dug into the logs.`, `Delaware is a state.`, `We covered caching in depth.`

### vocab/tapestry

Ornamental metaphors ("tapestry", "testament"). Default: `warning`.

- Why: Decorative metaphors ("rich tapestry", "a testament to", "the realm of") add tone, not information.
- Fix: Say the literal thing: who, what, how many.
- Flagged: `Our community is a rich tapestry of contributors.`, `This release is a testament to our team's dedication.`, `In the realm of databases, Postgres stands out.`, `The docs are a treasure trove of tips.`
- Not flagged: `The museum displays a medieval tapestry.`, `The Kerberos realm is set in krb5.conf.`, `The test is a regression check for issue 42.`

### vocab/hype-adjectives

Hype adjectives ("seamless", "cutting-edge"). Default: `warning`.

- Why: Unfalsifiable praise. Every product claims it, so it tells the reader nothing.
- Fix: Replace with a measurable fact: a number, a comparison, a constraint.
- Flagged: `A seamless, cutting-edge experience.`, `Our world-class team built a revolutionary product.`, `Blazing-fast builds with robust error handling.`
- Not flagged: `We use a robust estimator for the regression.`, `The seam ripped.`, `The edge cases are covered in tests.`, `Builds take 4 seconds on a 2020 laptop.`

### vocab/game-changer

"Game-changer", "next-level". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Inflated impact claims that readers discount immediately.
- Fix: Describe what changes, for whom, and by how much.
- Flagged: `This plugin is a game-changer for teams.`, `Take your productivity to the next level.`, `A paradigm shift in how we write tests.`
- Not flagged: `The game crashed on level 3.`, `Recurse into the next level of the tree.`, `Level 2 cache misses dropped by 40%.`

### vocab/empty-verbs

Empty verbs ("unlock", "elevate", "empower"). Default: `warning`.

- Why: Motivational verbs that describe a feeling instead of an action the reader can take.
- Fix: Use the concrete verb: "search", "export", "run in CI", "cut build time".
- Flagged: `Unlock the full potential of your data.`, `Empower your team to ship faster.`, `Supercharge your workflow.`, `Elevate your writing.`
- Not flagged: `Unlock the screen with your PIN.`, `Run the installer with elevated privileges.`, `The test harness runs in CI.`, `Elevated error rates triggered the alert.`

### vocab/leverage-utilize

"Leverage", "utilize", "facilitate". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Longer, vaguer synonyms for "use" and "help". They make sentences sound like a press release.
- Fix: Use the short word.
- Flagged: `We utilize Redis for caching.`, `Leverage the power of TypeScript.`, `This tool facilitates collaboration.`
- Not flagged: `CPU utilization stayed under 40%.`, `The bank's leverage ratio fell.`, `A leveraged buyout closed in May.`, `We use Redis for caching.`

### vocab/journey

"Journey", "embark on". Default: `info`.

- Why: Frames ordinary tasks as a voyage. Common in generated onboarding and marketing copy.
- Fix: Name the task: "setup", "the first week", "learning Rust".
- Flagged: `Your journey to clean code starts here.`, `We embarked on a mission to fix onboarding.`, `Thanks for joining us on this journey.`
- Not flagged: `Map the customer journey before designing the funnel.`, `The user journey ends at checkout.`, `The trip took four hours.`

### vocab/gravitas

Gravitas words ("pivotal", "crucial", "meticulous"). Default: `info`.

- Why: Each word is fine alone. Stacked, they inflate every sentence to the same pitch of importance.
- Fix: Keep the one place where it matters; cut the rest.
- Flagged: `It is crucial to plan. A meticulous, comprehensive approach is paramount.`, `This pivotal release brings a comprehensive, meticulous redesign.`, `A myriad of crucial, intricate details.`
- Not flagged: `This step is crucial: back up the database first.`, `The comprehensive test suite runs nightly.`, `We fixed an intricate race condition in the scheduler, which took two weeks of bisecting.`

### vocab/intensifiers

Stacked intensifiers ("truly", "incredibly"). Default: `info`.

- Why: Intensifiers used in bulk read as enthusiasm without evidence.
- Fix: Delete them, then check whether the sentence lost any meaning. It usually did not.
- Flagged: `Truly fast, incredibly simple, and absolutely free.`, `We are deeply, genuinely, profoundly grateful.`, `An exceptionally, remarkably, utterly simple API.`
- Not flagged: `We are deeply grateful to our contributors.`, `This is absolutely required for the build.`, `It truly works offline.`

### vocab/corporate-speak

Corporate jargon ("synergy", "actionable insights"). Default: `warning`.

- Why: Boardroom filler that makes technical writing vaguer.
- Fix: Say what the reader gets: "a weekly CSV of failed jobs", not "actionable insights".
- Flagged: `We drive synergy across teams.`, `Get actionable insights from your data.`, `A holistic, best-in-class platform.`
- Not flagged: `Read the logs for insight into the crash.`, `The fruit tree is low.`, `Our CI runs end-to-end tests.`

### vocab/tr-empty-hype

Somut bilgi vermeyen pazarlama kalıbı. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Somut bilgi vermeyen pazarlama kalıbı. Bu ifade, somut bilgi yerine hazır bir anlatım kalıbı kullanıyor.
- Fix: Kalıbı kaldırın; yerine somut bilgiyi, sonucu veya yapılacak işi yazın.
- Flagged: `Potansiyelinizi açığa çıkarın ve başlayın.`, `Oyunun kurallarını değiştiren bir çözüm.`
- Not flagged: `Oyun kurallarını menüden okuyun.`, `Dosyaları iki saniyede sıkıştırır.`, `Deneyim süresi on dakikadır.`

### vocab/it-empty-hype

sblocca tutto il tuo potenziale. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Questa formula generica ritarda i fatti e potrebbe comparire in un testo su qualsiasi argomento.
- Fix: Elimina la formula e indica il fatto, il risultato o la prossima azione concreta.
- Flagged: `sblocca tutto il tuo potenziale.`, `porta la tua attività al livello successivo.`
- Not flagged: `Abbiamo corretto il problema di accesso.`, `Il file occupa due megabyte.`, `Il modello funziona senza rete.`

### vocab/nl-empty-hype

ontgrendel je volledige potentieel. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Deze algemene formulering stelt concrete informatie uit en past bij vrijwel ieder onderwerp.
- Fix: Schrap de formulering en noem het concrete feit, resultaat of de volgende stap.
- Flagged: `ontgrendel je volledige potentieel.`, `til je bedrijf naar een hoger niveau.`
- Not flagged: `We hebben de inlogfout verholpen.`, `Het bestand is twee megabyte groot.`, `Het model werkt zonder netwerk.`

### vocab/ru-empty-hype

раскройте весь свой потенциал. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Этот шаблонный оборот откладывает конкретную информацию и подходит почти к любой теме.
- Fix: Уберите шаблон и укажите конкретный факт, результат или следующее действие.
- Flagged: `раскройте весь свой потенциал.`, `выведите свой бизнес на новый уровень.`
- Not flagged: `Мы исправили ошибку входа.`, `Размер файла — два мегабайта.`, `Модель работает без сети.`

### vocab/ar-empty-hype

أطلق العنان لإمكاناتك. Default: `warning`.

- Why: هذه عبارة عامة تؤخر المعلومة المحددة ويمكن استخدامها في نص عن أي موضوع تقريبا.
- Fix: احذف العبارة واذكر المعلومة المحددة أو النتيجة أو الخطوة التالية.
- Flagged: `أطلق العنان لإمكاناتك.`, `ارتق بأعمالك إلى المستوى التالي.`
- Not flagged: `أصلحنا خطأ تسجيل الدخول.`, `حجم الملف اثنان ميغابايت.`, `يعمل النموذج دون اتصال بالشبكة.`

### vocab/es-empty-hype

desbloquea todo tu potencial. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica retrasa la información concreta y puede aparecer en textos sobre cualquier tema.
- Fix: Elimina la fórmula y escribe el dato, el resultado o la acción concreta.
- Flagged: `desbloquea todo tu potencial.`, `lleva tu negocio al siguiente nivel.`
- Not flagged: `Hoy corregimos el error de acceso.`, `El archivo ocupa dos megabytes.`, `El modelo funciona sin conexión.`

### vocab/fr-empty-hype

libérez tout votre potentiel. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Cette formule générique retarde les faits et pourrait figurer dans un texte sur presque tous les sujets.
- Fix: Supprimez la formule et indiquez le fait, le résultat ou la prochaine action.
- Flagged: `libérez tout votre potentiel.`, `propulsez votre entreprise vers de nouveaux sommets.`
- Not flagged: `Nous avons corrigé l’erreur de connexion.`, `Le fichier mesure deux mégaoctets.`, `Le modèle fonctionne sans connexion.`

entfesseln Sie Ihr volles Potenzial. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Diese allgemeine Floskel verzögert die konkrete Information und passt zu fast jedem beliebigen Thema.
- Fix: Streichen Sie die Floskel und nennen Sie die konkrete Information, das Ergebnis oder den nächsten Schritt.
- Flagged: `entfesseln Sie Ihr volles Potenzial.`, `heben Sie Ihr Unternehmen auf das nächste Level.`
- Not flagged: `Wir haben den Anmeldefehler behoben.`, `Die Datei ist zwei Megabyte groß.`, `Das Modell arbeitet ohne Netzwerk.`

desbloqueie todo o seu potencial. Default: `warning`.

- Not flagged: `Corrigimos o erro de acesso hoje.`, `O arquivo ocupa dois megabytes.`, `O modelo funciona sem conexão.`

## Structure

Sentence and paragraph shapes that repeat across generated text.

### structure/not-just-x

"It's not just X, it's Y". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A manufactured contrast. It denies a claim nobody made in order to restate the same claim louder.
- Fix: State Y directly. If X matters, give it its own sentence.
- Flagged: `It's not just a linter, it's a writing coach.`, `This isn't just a tool — it's a movement.`, `It's not about speed. It's about trust.`, `Sloplint is more than just a linter.`, `Rejection isn't failure — it's feedback.`, `Don't just work harder — work smarter.`
- Not flagged: `It's not just slow; the query also locks the table.`, `The flag isn't required — the default is fine.`, `Don't just copy the key; rotate it.`, `This is not only a bug fix but also a refactor.`, `The cache isn't just for reads; writes go through it too.`

### structure/rule-of-three

Everything in threes. Default: `info`.

- Why: Triplets ("fast, simple, and powerful") on repeat give text a sing-song cadence that readers associate with generated copy.
- Fix: Keep the one or two items that matter. Vary list length.
- Flagged: `Fast, simple, and powerful. Clean, modern, and elegant. Learn, build, and grow.`, `Write, test, and ship. Plan, track, and measure. Secure, private, and free.`, `We value speed, quality, and trust. Our tools are fast, safe, and fun. Join, share, and grow.`
- Not flagged: `It runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows.`, `Install it, then run it.`, `Fast and simple.`, `| a | tweet, thread, or post |⏎| b | readme, docs, or wiki |⏎| c | email, memo, or note |`

### structure/colon-reveal

"The result? …". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A fake suspense beat: a one-word question answered immediately. Common in generated social posts.
- Fix: Merge it into one sentence: "Builds got 40% faster."
- Flagged: `The result? Builds are 40% faster.`, `The best part? It's free.`, `The secret? Caching everything.`
- Not flagged: `What was the result? We don't know yet.`, `The result is a 40% faster build.`, `## The result?`

### structure/heres-why

"Here's why:". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A drumroll line that delays the content it announces.
- Fix: Delete it and start with the reason.
- Flagged: `Here's why:`, `Here's the thing: nobody reads docs.`, `Here's what you need to know.`, `Here's where it gets interesting.`, `Here's what I learned:`
- Not flagged: `Here's why the build failed: the cache key changed.`, `Here's how to install it on Windows.`, `Here is the config file.`

### structure/whether-youre

"Whether you're a beginner or an expert". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Addresses every possible reader at once, which means it speaks to none of them.
- Fix: Name the reader you wrote this for, or drop the sentence.
- Flagged: `Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting out, this guide is for you.`, `Whether you're a solo founder or an enterprise team, we've got you covered.`, `Whether you are a student or a professional, sloplint helps.`
- Not flagged: `Whether you're on macOS or Linux, run the same command.`, `Check whether you are a member of the admin group.`, `Whether it's cached or not depends on the header.`

### structure/one-line-paragraphs

Run of one-sentence paragraphs. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Many consecutive one-sentence paragraphs ("broetry") is a LinkedIn growth-hack format that reads as filler.
- Fix: Group related sentences into paragraphs.
- Flagged: `I got fired.⏎⏎It hurt.⏎⏎Then I learned something.⏎⏎Rejection is data.⏎⏎Now I run a company.`, `We shipped.⏎⏎Users came.⏎⏎The servers melted.⏎⏎We fixed it.⏎⏎Now we scale.⏎⏎Lesson learned.`
- Not flagged: `We shipped.⏎⏎Users came.⏎⏎The servers melted.`, `We shipped v2 on Monday. Signups doubled by Wednesday.⏎⏎The database fell over twice. We added a read replica and a queue.`, `- one.⏎- two.⏎- three.⏎- four.⏎- five.`

### structure/question-endings

Paragraphs ending in questions. Default: `warning`.

- Why: When most paragraphs end on a question, the text keeps asking instead of saying.
- Fix: Answer the question in the text, or cut it.
- Flagged: `Builds are slow. Why does that happen?⏎⏎Caches miss a lot. What can we do?⏎⏎We could add a CDN. But is it worth it?`, `Ever shipped on a Friday?⏎⏎Who has time for tests?⏎⏎Is speed the only thing that matters?`
- Not flagged: `## Why is it slow?⏎⏎The cache misses.⏎⏎## How do I fix it?⏎⏎Warm the cache.⏎⏎## Does it work offline?⏎⏎Yes.`, `Is it fast? Yes.⏎⏎It runs in 2ms per file.⏎⏎It works offline.`, `Should you upgrade? Only if you use plugins.⏎⏎What breaks? The config format.⏎⏎Migration takes about ten minutes with the codemod.`

### structure/bold-label-bullets

"**Label:** description" bullets. Default: `info`.

- Why: Long lists where every item opens with a bolded label and colon are a signature of generated READMEs.
- Fix: Use plain bullets, a table, or prose. Bold only the item a reader must not miss.
- Flagged: `- **Fast:** builds in 2s⏎- **Simple:** one command⏎- **Safe:** no network⏎- **Free:** MIT licensed`, `1. **Install:** run npm i⏎2. **Configure:** add a file⏎3. **Run:** call the CLI⏎4. **Ship:** push it`
- Not flagged: `- **Fast:** builds in 2s⏎- **Simple:** one command⏎- **Safe:** no network`, `- builds in 2s⏎- one command⏎- no network⏎- MIT licensed`, `- **Note** the flag⏎- **Read** the docs⏎- run it⏎- ship it`

## Formatting

Punctuation, emoji and emphasis habits.

### format/em-dash-density

Em-dash overuse. Default: `info`.

- Why: Em-dashes are fine. Many of them in a short text is one of the most recognised marks of model output.
- Fix: Use a period, comma, colon or parentheses for most of them.
- Flagged: `Fast — really fast — and simple — very simple.`, `It works -- mostly -- unless -- of course -- it does not.`, `We shipped — finally. Users noticed — immediately. Support tickets — gone.`
- Not flagged: `It's fast — about 2ms per file.`, `Pages 10–20 cover setup.`, ``Run `a -- b -- c -- d` to pass args.``

### format/emoji-headings

Emoji in headings. Default: `warning`.

- Why: A rocket or sparkle on every heading is the default look of generated READMEs and adds no information.
- Fix: Remove the emoji. Headings work as navigation; keep them plain.
- Flagged: `## 🚀 Features⏎⏎## 📦 Installation`, `# Title ✨⏎⏎## Usage 🔥`, `## ✅ Pros⏎⏎## ❌ Cons⏎⏎## 💡 Tips`
- Not flagged: `## Features⏎⏎## Installation`, `# 🦀 crabby⏎⏎## Install`, ``## Use `:rocket:` in commit messages⏎⏎## Use `:bug:` for fixes``, `## Copyright © 2026⏎⏎## Trademarks™`

### format/emoji-bullets

Emoji as bullet points. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Lines that start with ✅ 🚀 👉 imitate a marketing template and make lists harder to scan.
- Fix: Use normal list markers. Keep at most one emoji where it carries meaning.
- Flagged: `✅ Fast⏎✅ Simple⏎✅ Free`, `- 🚀 Deploy⏎- 🔒 Secure⏎- 📈 Scale`, `👉 Step one⏎⏎👉 Step two⏎⏎👉 Step three`
- Not flagged: `✅ Done`, `- Deploy⏎- Secure⏎- Scale`, `🚀 Launch day.⏎⏎🎉 Thanks all.`

### format/excessive-bold

Too much bold. Default: `warning`.

- Why: When many phrases are bold, none of them stand out. Scattered bold is a common habit of chat models.
- Fix: Bold at most one phrase per section, the one a skimming reader must not miss.
- Flagged: `This tool is **fast**, **simple** and **secure**. It is **free** and works **offline**.`, `**Important:** run the **migration** before you **deploy**, otherwise the **cache** breaks.`
- Not flagged: `Run the migration **before** you deploy.`, `- **Fast:** 2s builds⏎- **Small:** 4 kB⏎- **Safe:** no network⏎- **Free:** MIT`, `**Note:** this needs Node 20.`

### format/exclamation-overuse

Exclamation marks. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Exclamation marks used as default punctuation read as forced enthusiasm.
- Fix: Use periods. Keep an exclamation mark for the one line that earns it.
- Flagged: `We're live! Try it now! You'll love it!`, `Huge news!!! v2 is out! Go!`
- Not flagged: `Done!`, ``Run `if (a != b) {}` first.``, `Thanks! See you Friday.`

### format/hashtag-stuffing

Hashtag stuffing. Default: `warning`.

- Why: A wall of hashtags at the end of a post is engagement bait and makes the text look automated.
- Fix: Keep one or two specific tags, or none.
- Flagged: `Shipped v2 today. #AI #DevTools #OpenSource #BuildInPublic`, `New post!⏎⏎#tech #startup #founder #growth #productivity`
- Not flagged: `Fixed in #123 and #456.`, `Follow #rustlang for updates.`, `Use #fff and #a0a0a0 for the background.`

## Hedging

Qualifiers that keep a claim from committing to anything.

### hedge/stacked

Stacked hedges ("may potentially"). Default: `warning`.

- Why: Two hedges on one claim. The writer is protecting themselves instead of informing the reader.
- Fix: Keep one hedge, or state the condition under which the claim holds.
- Flagged: `This may potentially improve performance.`, `It could be argued that tests are useful.`, `Perhaps maybe we should wait.`
- Not flagged: `This may improve performance.`, `Potential issues are listed below.`, `We could add a cache.`

### hedge/worth-noting

"It's worth noting that". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Throat-clearing before a fact. If it is worth noting, note it.
- Fix: Delete the lead-in and keep the fact.
- Flagged: `It's worth noting that the API is rate-limited.`, `It is important to note that this is a beta.`, `Needless to say, backups matter.`
- Not flagged: `Note: the API is rate-limited.`, `Worth reading: the RFC.`, `It is important for the cache to be warm.`

### hedge/qualifier-density

Qualifier pile-up. Default: `info`.

- Why: When most sentences carry "generally", "arguably" or "to some extent", the text commits to nothing.
- Fix: Commit where you can. Where you cannot, say what the exception is.
- Flagged: `Generally, it is somewhat faster and arguably, in many cases, relatively stable.`, `It typically works and is potentially, to some extent, more or less reliable.`
- Not flagged: `It is generally faster.`, `Builds typically take 2 minutes, and caching tends to help.`, `It is faster on every benchmark we ran.`

### hedge/tr-worth-noting

Bilgiyi geciktiren vurgu kalıbı. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Bilgiyi geciktiren vurgu kalıbı. Bu ifade, somut bilgi yerine hazır bir anlatım kalıbı kullanıyor.
- Fix: Kalıbı kaldırın; yerine somut bilgiyi, sonucu veya yapılacak işi yazın.
- Flagged: `Belirtmekte fayda var, işlem ücretsiz.`, `Altını çizmek gerekir: dosya silinmez.`
- Not flagged: `İşlem ücretsizdir.`, `Satırın altını çizmek için düğmeye basın.`, `Dosya diskte kalır.`

### hedge/it-worth-noting

è importante sottolineare che. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Questa formula generica ritarda i fatti e potrebbe comparire in un testo su qualsiasi argomento.
- Fix: Elimina la formula e indica il fatto, il risultato o la prossima azione concreta.
- Flagged: `è importante sottolineare che.`, `vale la pena notare che.`
- Not flagged: `Abbiamo corretto il problema di accesso.`, `Il file occupa due megabyte.`, `Il modello funziona senza rete.`

### hedge/nl-worth-noting

het is belangrijk om op te merken dat. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Deze algemene formulering stelt concrete informatie uit en past bij vrijwel ieder onderwerp.
- Fix: Schrap de formulering en noem het concrete feit, resultaat of de volgende stap.
- Flagged: `het is belangrijk om op te merken dat.`, `het is vermeldenswaard dat.`
- Not flagged: `We hebben de inlogfout verholpen.`, `Het bestand is twee megabyte groot.`, `Het model werkt zonder netwerk.`

### hedge/ru-worth-noting

важно отметить, что. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Этот шаблонный оборот откладывает конкретную информацию и подходит почти к любой теме.
- Fix: Уберите шаблон и укажите конкретный факт, результат или следующее действие.
- Flagged: `важно отметить, что.`, `стоит подчеркнуть, что.`
- Not flagged: `Мы исправили ошибку входа.`, `Размер файла — два мегабайта.`, `Модель работает без сети.`

### hedge/ar-worth-noting

من الجدير بالذكر أن. Default: `warning`.

- Why: هذه عبارة عامة تؤخر المعلومة المحددة ويمكن استخدامها في نص عن أي موضوع تقريبا.
- Fix: احذف العبارة واذكر المعلومة المحددة أو النتيجة أو الخطوة التالية.
- Flagged: `من الجدير بالذكر أن.`, `تجدر الإشارة إلى أن.`
- Not flagged: `أصلحنا خطأ تسجيل الدخول.`, `حجم الملف اثنان ميغابايت.`, `يعمل النموذج دون اتصال بالشبكة.`

### hedge/es-worth-noting

cabe destacar que. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica retrasa la información concreta y puede aparecer en textos sobre cualquier tema.
- Fix: Elimina la fórmula y escribe el dato, el resultado o la acción concreta.
- Flagged: `cabe destacar que.`, `es importante señalar que.`
- Not flagged: `Hoy corregimos el error de acceso.`, `El archivo ocupa dos megabytes.`, `El modelo funciona sin conexión.`

### hedge/fr-worth-noting

il est important de noter que. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Cette formule générique retarde les faits et pourrait figurer dans un texte sur presque tous les sujets.
- Fix: Supprimez la formule et indiquez le fait, le résultat ou la prochaine action.
- Flagged: `il est important de noter que.`, `il convient de souligner que.`
- Not flagged: `Nous avons corrigé l’erreur de connexion.`, `Le fichier mesure deux mégaoctets.`, `Le modèle fonctionne sans connexion.`

### hedge/de-worth-noting

es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Diese allgemeine Floskel verzögert die konkrete Information und passt zu fast jedem beliebigen Thema.
- Fix: Streichen Sie die Floskel und nennen Sie die konkrete Information, das Ergebnis oder den nächsten Schritt.
- Flagged: `es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass.`, `es sollte hervorgehoben werden, dass.`
- Not flagged: `Wir haben den Anmeldefehler behoben.`, `Die Datei ist zwei Megabyte groß.`, `Das Modell arbeitet ohne Netzwerk.`

### hedge/pt-worth-noting

é importante ressaltar que. Default: `warning`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica adia a informação concreta e poderia aparecer em textos sobre qualquer assunto.
- Fix: Remova a fórmula e apresente o dado, o resultado ou a ação concreta.
- Flagged: `é importante ressaltar que.`, `vale a pena destacar que.`
- Not flagged: `Corrigimos o erro de acesso hoje.`, `O arquivo ocupa dois megabytes.`, `O modelo funciona sem conexão.`

## Closers

Template endings, summaries and calls for engagement.

### closer/in-conclusion

"In conclusion". Default: `warning`.

- Why: An essay-template closer that announces a summary of what the reader just read.
- Fix: End on the last useful sentence, or a concrete next step.
- Flagged: `In conclusion, sloplint helps.`, `To sum up, the release is great.`, `We fixed the cache.⏎⏎Ultimately, it's about trust.`
- Not flagged: `We reached a conclusion after testing.`, `Ultimately, the cache was at fault.⏎⏎The fix landed in #42.`, `The summary table is below.`

### closer/engagement-bait

"What do you think? Let me know in the comments". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A generic call for engagement. It asks the reader to do the work of making the post matter.
- Fix: Ask a specific question only you could ask, or end without one.
- Flagged: `What do you think? Let me know in the comments.`, `Thoughts?`, `Agree? ♻️ Repost to help others.`, `Follow me for more tips like this.`
- Not flagged: `We asked users what they think of the new layout.`, `The thoughts above are mine.`, `Agreed, let's ship it.`

### closer/hope-this-helps

"Hope this helps! Feel free to reach out". Default: `warning`.

- Why: Customer-service sign-offs that pad the end of a document or message.
- Fix: Delete it. If there is a real support channel, link it once.
- Flagged: `Hope this helps!`, `Feel free to reach out with questions.`, `Happy coding!`, `Don't hesitate to contact me.`
- Not flagged: `This helps when the cache is cold.`, `Reach out to the on-call engineer if the job fails.`, `Questions go in GitHub Discussions.`

### closer/future-is-bright

"The future is bright". Default: `warning`.

- Why: A vague upbeat ending with no content. It could close any text ever written.
- Fix: End with what ships next, with a date if you have one.
- Flagged: `The possibilities are endless.`, `This is just the beginning.`, `The future of testing is here.`
- Not flagged: `The future API will add pagination.`, `Possibilities include caching and batching.`, `We start at the beginning of the file.`

### closer/tr-template-ending

İçeriğe katkı yapmayan kapanış. Default: `warning`.

- Why: İçeriğe katkı yapmayan kapanış. Bu ifade, somut bilgi yerine hazır bir anlatım kalıbı kullanıyor.
- Fix: Kalıbı kaldırın; yerine somut bilgiyi, sonucu veya yapılacak işi yazın.
- Flagged: `Sonuç olarak söylemek gerekirse, seçim sizin.`, `Umarım bu bilgiler faydalı olmuştur.`
- Not flagged: `Sonuç dosyasını kaydedin.`, `Yarın saat onda görüşürüz.`, `Kurulum için komutu çalıştırın.`

## Leftovers

Assistant disclaimers and unfilled placeholders.

### filler/ai-self-reference

Leftover assistant text and placeholders. Default: `error`.

- Why: Model disclaimers ("As an AI language model") or unfilled template slots ("[Your Name]") prove nobody read the text before publishing.
- Fix: Delete the disclaimer. Fill in or remove every placeholder.
- Flagged: `As an AI language model, I can't predict prices.`, `As of my last update, the API was in beta.`, `Best regards,⏎[Your Name]`, `Thanks for considering [Company Name].`
- Not flagged: `As an AI researcher, she studies alignment.`, `Our AI model updates nightly.`, `See [the docs](https://example.com) for details.`, `- [x] Your name is set`

- Fix: Schrap de formulering en noem het concrete feit, resultaat of de volgende stap.
- Flagged: `als AI-taalmodel kan ik.`, `als kunstmatig taalmodel kan ik.`
- Not flagged: `We hebben de inlogfout verholpen.`, `Het bestand is twee megabyte groot.`, `Het model werkt zonder netwerk.`

### filler/ru-assistant-preamble

как языковая модель искусственного интеллекта. Default: `error`.

- Fix: Уберите шаблон и укажите конкретный факт, результат или следующее действие.
- Flagged: `как языковая модель искусственного интеллекта.`, `как большая языковая модель я.`

### filler/es-assistant-preamble

como modelo de lenguaje de inteligencia artificial. Default: `error`.

- Why: Esta fórmula genérica retrasa la información concreta y puede aparecer en textos sobre cualquier tema.
